# `assets/import/OrientationResolver.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/OrientationResolver.js`

engine/assets/import/OrientationResolver.js — axis/scale/origin inference (spec §6). Never trust source orientation; never bake corrections into source. We infer a non-destructive ImportTransform (axis correction quat + scale + origin) with a confidence, and a policy decides whether to auto-apply, mark reviewable, preview only, or stay neutral and require manual correction.

## Functions

### `classifyConfidence(c)`

### `resolveOrientation(model, opts = {})`

Infer an ImportTransform for a model.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel (uses sourceFormat + bounds)
- `[opts]` *(object)* — { unitHint, upAxis, forwardAxis } explicit overrides win

**Returns:** }
